title: LearnHub access token claims
description: The decoded claim set of every access token auth-service issues and api-gateway verifies (HS256, research.md R1). Never serialized on its own; always carried as a signed JWT in the Authorization header, and never forwarded past the gateway (FR-020).

role.description: The account's role at the moment this token was issued; not re-checked against the account's current role until the next login (spec.md Clarifications).

exp.description: Expiry time, seconds since epoch; iat + 900 (15 minutes, FR-006).
